description_en: Updates the time period of a sound code schedule
description_zh: 调用该接口更新声码排程时间段
name: UpdateSchedulePeriod

parameters.help_en: The sound code parsing content for the time period. The value must be 1 to 512 characters in length. Each Chinese character occupies two characters
parameters.help_zh: 时间段声码解析内容，长度为1~512个字符，一个汉字占两个字符
parameters.name: sound_code_content

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the time period
parameters.name: period_code

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。</ph></props>

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the time period. The value must be 1 to 64 characters in length. Each Chinese character occupies two characters
parameters.help_zh: 时间段描述，长度为1~64个字符，一个汉字占两个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The start time of the time period. The value is in the 24-hour format and ranges from 00:00 to 23:59
parameters.help_zh: 时间段开始时间，格式为二十四小时制时间，范围为00:00~23:59
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the time period. The value is in the 24-hour format and ranges from 00:00 to 23:59. The value cannot be earlier than StartTime
parameters.help_zh: 时间段结束时间，格式为二十四小时制时间，范围为00:00~23:59，不能早于StartTime
parameters.name: end_time

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息
ErrorMessage.example: sound code service has not been signed

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
